description.value: Mount Lehman Library is a small community branch of the Fraser Valley Regional Library system serving the rural Mount Lehman area east of Abbotsford. As a public library, it offers free WiFi, public computers, all-gender washrooms, and a 24-hour item return drop. It is a welcoming, accessible public space on a rural road corridor where amenities are otherwise sparse.

address.value: 5875 Mount Lehman Road, Abbotsford, BC V4X 1V5

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The library's own location page confirms the address, phone number, and lists facility features explicitly: WiFi, All Gender Restrooms, public computers, copying/printing, and a 24-hour item return slot. No bike parking, bike rack, water refill, or any cycling-specific amenity is mentioned anywhere on the website or in the OSM tags, so those fields remain null. The website is live and substantively corroborates all OSM contact details.
concerns: OSM address omits city name 'Abbotsford'; website confirms full address as 5875 Mount Lehman Road, Abbotsford, BC V4X 1V5.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Bike parking — a required criterion — cannot be confirmed from the website or OSM tags. The library offers washrooms and WiFi useful to cyclists, but without confirmed bike parking it does not clearly meet the minimum required criteria for a WWC listing.

wow_evidence: Library ladder 1/1; rare public space on a rural corridor.
blurb: Small rural library branch in Mount Lehman.
